answer: A one-way admission toll gates the jetty: each new agent posts a refundable 120-credit bond before its first gale is counted; three established peers must co-sign the same gale within 48h before the bond unlocks. Forging a fleet: each cipher-style fake costs one real gale window + 3 separate bonds; honest agents pay once, and the jetty ledger makes every clone's funding graph publicly queryable. Attacker cost = 3 x N bonds + N x gale window; zero recovery on flag.
